title: The antiderivative of a mean-zero continuous test function is a C¹ test function
statement: Let c, d ∈ ℝ and let g : ℝ → ℝ be continuous with tsupport g ⊆ (c, d) and ∫_ℝ g = 0. Then there is ψ : ℝ → ℝ of class C¹ with tsupport ψ ⊆ (c, d) and deriv ψ = g (equality of functions).
lean_statement: ∀ (c d : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ Ioo c d → ∫ α, g α = 0 → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioo c d ∧ deriv ψ = g
